independence_evidence: Self-published literary magazine run from East Vancouver, funded by BC Arts Council, Canada Council for the Arts, Canada Periodical Fund and City of Vancouver (site footer and about page); no media-group owner.
qualifies_reason: Independent Vancouver literary magazine with print issues 100-103 dated 2025-2026 on sale in its own shop.
what_it_is: A Canadian literary magazine mixing short fiction, poetry, non-fiction essays and commentary with book reviews and columns on chapbooks and small-press publishing. Each issue carries work by a featured visual artist on the cover and inside, and some issues are built around a theme (recent ones include Dreams and Trash) while others are general. It suits readers of contemporary Canadian and international writing who want a print journal with a West Coast base and a stake in the small-press scene.
